messages:
emma-docs: FYI I opened a docs PR to add an Azure AD managed identity example for audit log storage + a short migration note for SDK v2 audit APIs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512
raj-legal: Thanks for the ping. Please keep SOC2 references advisory. Avoid prescriptive language like "must" unless it's contractually required. Suggest: "Recommended retention period (example): 90 days; confirm with your compliance contact."
olivia-security: Quick security note: the managed identity example in the draft grants broad storage permissions. Please show a least-privilege role (Storage Blob Data Writer scoped to the container) and include a SAS-token alternative. Also call out pseudonymization before export.
emma-docs: Current draft values snippet (working copy):

```
# values.yaml (example)
audIt:
  enabled: true
  retention_days: 90 # example, advisory only
  storage:
    provider: azure-blob
    container: redwood-audit
    use_managed_identity: true
    managed_identity_client_id: "{{ .Values.azure.managedIdentityClientId }}"
```

paco-devex: Can we add a TS SDK v2 example for infra provisioning? Folks copy that into automation. Example suggestion below.

```ts
// TS SDK v2 example
await client.audits.updateConfig({ retentionDays: 90, storage: { provider: 'azure-blob', container: 'redwood-audit' } });
```

raj-legal: Replace the inline `retention_days: 90` comment with wording that explicitly states it's an example and not a requirement, and add a link to the compliance alias. Also avoid the word "must".
olivia-security: Adding a short security callout would help. Under the example add: `# Use least privilege; prefer scoped roles or SAS tokens; avoid embedding long-lived credentials; pseudonymize/redact PII before exporting logs.`
emma-docs: Added SAS alternative and a small curl example for the infra API so SREs can automate retention toggles. Drafts below.

```
# generate SAS (example command)
az storage container generate-sas --name redwood-audit --permissions racwd --expiry 2026-01-01T00:00Z
```

```bash
# curl set retention (example)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/config \ 
  -d '{"retention_days": 90, "storage": {"provider":"azure-blob","container":"redwood-audit"}}'
```

ci-bot: docs PR 512 checks: linkcheck passed, asciidoc build OK :white_check_mark:
raj-legal: LGTM for legal phrasing after the changes. One tiny ask: add contact pointer to `#compliance` and a note to contact them for regulated datasets.
emma-docs: Done 14 added compliance alias, softened phrasing to "recommended" in two places, added SAS alternative, and included the security callout. Merging once CI finishes. Thanks all! :rocket:
ci-bot: docs PR 512 merged to main; staging deploy queued.
